title: Engelbart pilot onboarding — Priya Raman
notes_markdown:
### Setup tour (10 min)

- Claude: 9 Projects + loose conversations; Zotero (~600 items); ~/Downloads full of PDFs; Obsidian daily notes (not connected — no connector yet)
- Paragraph she brought: chapter 2 intro on "help-seeking as a design material"

### Connect + import (live)

- Connected: Claude export, Zotero, Local PDFs (~/Downloads), skipped ChatGPT (doesn't use it)
- Connect screen: no hesitation on the main tiles; asked "is Obsidian under Other?" — no, Other is file upload
- Import summary: Claude 412 conversations imported; her account page says ~550 → **~140 Claude chats missing**
- Likely cause: export split into two files (conversations.json + a second part); importer only read the first — to verify
- Duplicates: same papers in Zotero and Downloads shown twice; badge only showed on 9 of ~30 obvious pairs (Downloads copies are publisher PDFs, Zotero has arXiv)
- Import time: ~11 minutes total; PDFs slowest

### Writing task (15 min)

- First confirmed suggestion at ~6 min into the task: a Claude chat from March where she worked out the "design material" framing
- Reaction: "Okay that's the thing. That's where that came from." — loved the "where did this thought come from" trail
- Wanted to see the Zotero note next to the paper in the trail, not just the PDF
- Annoyed by duplicate suggestions (same paper twice in the 3 candidates)

### Priya's asks

1. Get all her Claude chats (non-negotiable)
2. Collapse duplicate papers — at least in suggestions
3. Claude Projects as groups
4. Obsidian later

### Action items

- [ ] David — investigate missing ~140 Claude chats (multi-file export?) today
- [ ] David — dedupe in suggestions: never show two candidates with the same DOI/title
- [ ] Hudson — send Priya a summary + "what we'll fix" list
- [ ] Follow-up session in 1 week
